title: rubus macromontanus
intro: Rubus macromontanus, commonly known as Chinese bramble or large-fruited raspberry, is a species of raspberry native to China. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rubus macromontanus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which exhibit antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-cancer activities. Additionally, the plant's leaves and stems are used in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as edema, diarrhea, and sore throats.
